_note: Copied from the shipped TY 2026-27 timeline for W-146's synthetic pack, regime references renamed (NEW_TAX_REGIME -> SYN_DEFAULT, SYN_FLAT; FIRST_SCHEDULE_RATES -> SYN_CLASSIC); not law, never shipped. Original note: Interest at 1 % a month for a return furnished late, from the day after the due date to furnishing, on tax less advance tax, tax at source and reliefs. 1961 s.234A says 'every month or part of a month'; 2025 s.423 says only 'number of months', so statesPartOfMonth differs and a part month is counted whole only as the reading OQ-39 records (D-446 C3a). Sources: sources/2026-11-06-advance-tax-interest.md; D-446.
